plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing build phase with Week 1 used to establish training maxes on the main percentage-based lifts so the main loading can start in Week 2. The block builds general strength first, keeps simple explosive work in each session, and adds only moderate conditioning so you can handle more sparring without the lifting work becoming junk fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish training maxes in Week 1, then build simple full-body strength, basic power, and aerobic support with recoverable volume.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Push the main lifts and medicine-ball power a little harder while trimming extra volume if sparring rises.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen faster outputs, and express power and speed with lower fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can and land softly. Full reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and stick the landing clean.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard top set with clean depth and posture. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the weight and reps so the app can set your training numbers.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the goblet hold limits load before the legs do.

exercises.name: 3. Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Keep a soft knee bend and reach the hips back. Stop when hamstring tension is high and the back stays flat.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a lighter load and control balance.

exercises.name: 4. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Brace hard on the support hand and pull the elbow toward the hip. No twisting.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Good option if lower-back fatigue is high.

exercises.name: 5. Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.notes: Move under control and keep the ribcage stacked as you lower.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Sit-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if a bench or anchor is not available.

exercises.name: 6. Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall, stay tight through the trunk, and keep the steps smooth.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use one dumbbell and switch sides each set.

exercises.name: 1a. Plyometric Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode off the floor or off an elevated surface. Stop before speed drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench or box if full plyometric reps are too aggressive.

exercises.name: 2. Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard top set with both arms moving evenly. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the weight and reps so the app can set your training numbers.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a stable bench.

exercises.name: 3. Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use bodyweight only if every rep is clean and you can stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. If not, switch to band-assisted pull-ups.

substitutionOptions.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use enough help to keep clean reps and control the bottom.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no pull-up setup is available.

exercises.name: 4. Half-Kneeling One-Arm Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Squeeze the glute on the down knee side and keep the ribs down as you press.

substitutionOptions.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if kneeling space is limited.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Make a straight line from shoulder to ankle and keep the hips high.

exercises.name: 6. Neck Flexion Isometric
exercises.notes: Use your hand or a towel for light resistance only. Smooth pressure, no jerking.

substitutionOptions.name: Supine Chin Tuck Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if direct neck loading feels awkward.
